description: This PHP class defines 'EndpointGetAllResult', a serializer class used in the OrangeHRM API v2 to handle normalization of endpoint results. It extends 'AbstractEndpointResult' and implements a normalize method that returns a normalized array, either by normalizing an object or an array of objects, based on the model's interfaces.

classes.name: EndpointGetAllResult
classes.description: A deprecated serializer class for endpoint result normalization in OrangeHRM's API v2.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns a normalized array representation of the endpoint result, choosing between object or objects array normalization based on the model's implemented interfaces.
